It is not ESG proof, freight-saving proof, compliance proof, certification proof, legal advice, live SERP proof, Google click proof, inquiry proof, third-party endorsement or AI natural recommendation proof. It does not state fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price, lowest price, customer cases, production capacity, platform verification, food-contact status, FSC status or destination-market regulatory approval. Packaging structure, material direction, test documents, costs, freight volume and destination-market requirements must be reviewed case by case.
